resources.string: After both screens confirm, the selected MeloX phone receiver can see the current title, artist and lyrics. Keep that display private. Turning this off stops the current session immediately.
Use the Bluetooth lyrics screen in the MeloX Android companion. Both devices need Classic Bluetooth and system pairing. Ordinary headphones and audio metadata do not receive these lyrics.
Save before connecting. A saved setting never connects automatically.
Setting was not confirmed saved. Keep the draft and retry after storage is available.
Settings changed elsewhere. Reload the saved value before editing again.
Saved settings are unavailable. Temporary defaults cannot authorize a connection.
Bluetooth connection permission is needed only for this paired-device session. No discovery or location permission is used.
No paired devices. Pair the phone in system Bluetooth settings first.
Compare these eight digits on both screens. Confirm only when all digits match.
Waiting for both screens to confirm…
A previous operation is still active. Close it before starting another.
Classic Bluetooth or the system connection service is unavailable.
Bluetooth is off. Enable it in system settings.
System pairing is required for this connection.
The connected device does not have the required receiver role.
Both screens did not confirm. Start a fresh connection to try again.
The session timed out. Start a fresh connection.
The Bluetooth connection was lost. Old content has been cleared.
The received message was invalid. The connection is closed.
The Bluetooth lyrics protocol versions are incompatible.
The connection could not be authenticated. No lyrics are shared.
The peer sent messages too quickly. The connection is closed.
The previous connection has not finished closing. Retry closure before reconnecting.
